summary: Phase 2.5E backend hardening validated. 32/32 new tests pass (test_phase2_5e_sign.py) + 21/21 regression from 2.5D pass. Coverage: C3+ (session_id+session_number em financial_entries, incluindo parcelas), C4/C5 (POST /attendance/{sid}/sign happy path + errors + persistence + copy on finalize), C7 (autosave identity fields ignored, partial payload, 422 quando patient_id ausente, last-write-wins), regression (idempotência, status transitions, RBAC full, dashboard, finance, budgets, AI, recibos, medical records).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py está com ~4607 linhas — recomenda-se modularizar (auth, attendance, finance, medical_records) em routers separados para reduzir complexidade e melhorar manutenibilidade.
Endpoint /attendance/{sid}/sign usa Dict[str, Any] no body — recomenda-se criar Pydantic model (SignPayload) com type Literal['consent','evolution'] para validação nativa (evita branch manual).
seed_data_creation: Reused existing patient (first from GET /api/patients). Created multiple TEST appointments/sessions for sign+finalize flows. No cleanup needed (test data uses TEST_ prefix where applicable).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2.5E fully validated. New endpoint POST /api/attendance/{sid}/sign works with SHA256 hash, ISO signed_at, timezone, ip (X-Forwarded-For fallback to request.client.host), signed_by, and echoes session_id/appointment_id/patient_id. On /finalize, both consent_signature/evolution_signature + their _meta dicts are copied to medical_records. financial_entries now contain session_id + session_number (ATT-YYYY-######); installments share group_id + same session_id + session_number. PUT /api/attendance/{sid} pops appointment_id/patient_id server-side. Legacy records/entries without these new fields coexist without breaking listings. Test file: /app/backend/tests/test_phase2_5e_sign.py.
